description: This file defines the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class responsible for integrating social media authentication (specifically OpenID Connect) within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for initiating authentication, handling user identities, and checking feature enablement.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationService
classes.description: Service class for handling social media (OpenID Connect) authentication, user identity management, and feature enabling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of AuthProviderDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getUserDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of UserDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initiateAuthentication
methods.description: Creates and configures an OpenID Connect client for user authentication with the specified provider.

methods.name: getRedirectURL
methods.description: Generates the URL to redirect users to for OpenID connect login.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope string used in the OpenID connect requests, default is 'email'.

methods.name: getSystemUsers
methods.description: Searches and returns system users matching provided credentials.

methods.name: getUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Validates user credentials and returns the corresponding User object if valid.

methods.name: setOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Associates a User with an OpenIdProvider and creates an OpenIdUserIdentity record.

methods.name: handleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Sets authentication credentials for a user, completing the login process.

methods.name: isSocialMediaAuthEnable
methods.description: Checks whether social media (OpenID provider) authentication is currently enabled.
